spec_match.rationale: Teaches the real cross-engine parsererror contract — no exception, an error element whose namespace varies by engine (Mozilla ns in Firefox, XHTML in WebKit/Chrome) — verified against this engine's actual output and detected namespace-broadly.

interactive.rationale: Live-editing textarea plus five breakage presets; the tree dump and verdict recompute on every keystroke from real parses.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb (updated with the namespace nuance) matches the page's behavior.

edge_cases.rationale: Presets cover mismatched tags, undefined entities, multiple roots, and duplicate attributes; the valid preset proves the no-error path. The page's own first version detected only the Firefox namespace — a real bug the harness caught (Chrome reported success for broken XML) and the fix now teaches.

conformance.rationale: The suite's parsererror-contract assertion was corrected alongside the page to match the local name in any namespace.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP runs (fresh reload after the fix): the undefined-entity preset now correctly reports FAILED with namespace http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml and the engine's message, and the valid preset reports success; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: xmlr-anatomy-ran asserts with the failure flag and detected namespace.

design_system.rationale: well/broken verdicts emerald/amber on stone (AA); CSS variables only; ≥44px preset chips.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled textarea; preset group labelled; tree dump and verdict aria-live.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Duo panes collapse under 760px; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Compare error-document structure on the Rust engine
openQuestions.detail: On Chrome 153, run the same presets and confirm the error document's structure (element, namespace, placement) is unchanged; message wording may differ and that difference is legal.

guidanceConsulted.query: live editing textarea recompute on input
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Recompute derived views on input with labelled editors.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: aria-labelled textarea; run on every input event.
Verdict is role=status aria-live including the namespace and message.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the harness exposed that the page's first detection was Firefox-only (Chrome's XHTML-namespace parsererror slipped through as 'success'); the fixed page detects across namespaces, reports this engine's real flavour, and now teaches the nuance explicitly. Fresh-reload evidence on both viewports.
